description.narrative: Cooperation on chemicals risk management supporting Serbia's preparations for EU accession, including harmonisation of regulations, capacity building, especially on biocides, improved chemicals registry and communication. The project started in 2016, has been extended to 2022.

Insatsen är en fortsättning på ett långvarigt svenskt samarbete inom kemikalieområdet. Projektet som startade 2016 förlängdes 2020 till att fortgå till 2022. Det svenska stödet fokuserar på att fortsatt kompetensutveckling och harmonisering av nationell lagstiftning med EUs regelverk. Samarbetet innehåller också stöd till en uppgradering av det nationella kemikalieregistret, inkluderar IT-utveckling, samt ett brett arbete för institutionell utveckling för att klara av kommande EU-krav. Genom förlängningen ges ett ökat fokus till kommunikation till allmänheten.

The overall objective of the project was to strengthen Serbia´s preparation for EU chemical and biocidal legislation and management, which will improve movement of goods and chemical safety and health in Serbia and the EU. The project developed IT solutions, built administrative capacities, prepared appropriate legislation, and strengthened communication on EU chemical legislation. The project was implemented by the Swedish Chemicals Agency, KemI, together with the Department for Chemical Management at the Serbian Ministry for Environmental Protection. The project, started in 2016, and was finalized in 2022. The total time of cooperation between KemI and the Serbian Ministry of Environmental Protection was 13 years.
